parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the specified resource groups or members. Valid values:

*   false (default value)
*   true

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
The ID of a resource group or member.

You can specify a maximum of 50 IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the objects from which you want to remove tags. Valid values:

*   ResourceGroup: resource group. This is the default value.
*   Account: member.

>  This parameter is required if you remove tags from members in a resource directory.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description:
A tag key.

You can specify a maximum of 20 tag keys.

>  If you set the `All` parameter to `true`, you do not need to configure this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager untag-resources --all false --resource-id rg-aek2dpwyrfr0000 --tag-key k1 --resource-type ResourceGroup --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'rg-aek2dpwyrfr0000' --TagKey.1 k1 --ResourceType ResourceGroup --method POST --force
